disposition_reason: The original paper contains an ordered Figure 5i RF position-decoding task with published young and aged score strata. This source-native route is retained for the authorized canonical overhaul, while the old Figure 2 stability contrasts remain calibration. Exact original session/cell and fold bindings, the complete source score vector, author replay and a qualified decoder evaluator are unresolved; no convenient scalar or new split replaces the source comparison.

source_paper.title: Spatial coding dysfunction and network instability in the aging medial entorhinal cortex

evidence.locator: Results: Single-cell spatial coding correlates with heterogeneous spatial memory in aging; Figure 2; Methods: Cross-trial correlation matrices and spatial stability, and similarity; Statistical tools and reproducibility
evidence.supports: The selected output is a comparison of age groups, sessions and context-dependent firing statistics, estimated with nested models, rather than a held-out algorithm score.

evidence.locator: Figure 5i; Results: Aged spatial coding instability in an invariant VR environment; Methods: Position decoding analysis
evidence.supports: Original RF position decoding has a mean cosine angular prediction score, ten 90/10 train/test repetitions, 34 young and 27 aged sessions, and reported stratum means 0.6271 and 0.4683.

evidence.locator: August 18, 2025 deposit; README: Description of the data and file structure; MouseMetadata.csv and SessionMetadata.csv descriptions
evidence.supports: The release provides synchronized sorted spikes, VR position/trial context, mouse/session metadata and author shuffle scores. Array payloads were not inspected.

evidence.locator: README instructions 3-5 and Important Notes A; Figure 2 & Supplementary Fig. 3.ipynb
evidence.supports: Import/filter and classification precede figure reconstruction; random shuffle and clustering procedures can change counts and p-values without changing the descriptive conclusion.
Occupancy correction, Gaussian smoothing, per-cell normalization and normalized trial-map dot products underpin the historical calculation.

evidence.locator: Compare position decoding accuracy ... (Figure 5I-K); DECODER ANALYSIS/CircularRegression; train_vs_test_blocks; spatial-cell fitting; Load results ... only for k=2 sessions
evidence.supports: Pinned Figure 5 notebook supplies the circular decoder, ten-way test-index partition/random training selection, spatialcell99 and two-map eligibility, and random-map score averaged across repetitions. Original realized partitions and scores still need binding.

target.description: Predict RF track position from co-recorded spatial-cell activity, preserving the original Figure 5i young and aged session strata. Figure 2 biological contrasts remain calibration.

dataset.description: Herber et al. Dryad electrophysiology/VR deposit, DOI 10.5061/dryad.8cz8w9h0d; source Figure 5 notebook consumes its prepared RF session inputs.

cohort.description: Original Figure 5i includes 34 young and 27 aged RF sessions with more than ten spatial cells and optimal k=2. Exact mouse/session/cell identities and source eligibility realization are not bound; retain both strata without subset selection.

split.description: Paper specifies ten repetitions with 90% training and 10% testing within each session. Source train_vs_test_blocks partitions test indices ten ways and randomly selects eligible training indices; original downsampled indices, RNG state and folds are not recovered. New mouse-held-out or newly drawn folds are extensions.

inputs.description: Source-selected spatial-cell spiking/firing activity is the decoder input; synchronized VR track angle is the target. Preserve original RF input window, cell-selection and map eligibility.

preprocessing.description: Source uses spatial classification, map clustering and training downsampling/matching for spike number, position, speed and observation count. Pinned code smooths firing activity and selects spatialcell99; full native transformation/selection parity and saved indices need qualification.

metric.description: Decoder score is the mean of cos(true track angle minus predicted angle) over original test observations; higher is better, with 1 for perfect prediction.

aggregation.description: Average the ten decoder scores within each original session, then retain separate young and aged stratum summaries. Source Figure 5i uses the both-map/random-selection score; no pooled scalar is substituted.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 5i session-averaged cosine position-decoding score, preserving the young/aged comparison vector

published_baseline.description: The paper reports young 0.6271 +/-0.0406 SEM and aged 0.4683 +/-0.0416 SEM, over 34 and 27 sessions. These are two verified published stratum summaries, not one scalar baseline. The original full session/repetition score vector and its exact bindings remain unresolved; value is null rather than an invented pooled score.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Source route is Figure 5.ipynb: CircularRegression, train_vs_test_blocks, spatial-cell fitting and the final random-map row averaged over repetitions. No authentic same-fold author rerun or score-vector agreement has been established.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful cosine-score improvement and a decision rule preserving both original age strata must be justified before evaluation; no universal margin or conveniently pooled objective is imposed.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired candidate-versus-author score-vector analysis retaining source folds, sessions and age strata, with sessions clustered by mouse. No calibrated superiority rule is established.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse for biological uncertainty; repeated sessions, test bins and split repetitions remain dependent.
uncertainty.rationale: The published young-versus-aged test concerns biological differences, not candidate-versus-author superiority.

paper_win_requires: Recover and bind the exact original Figure 5i 61-session/two-age-stratum cohort, cell/map eligibility, preprocessing, downsampling and evaluation partitions.
Recover the original per-session score vector and establish a competent author replay; published stratum means and rerun scores must remain distinct.

Compare candidate and author under the same original inputs, folds, metric and within-session aggregation; retain both age strata and predeclare the full comparison rule without selecting favorable sessions or pooling a convenient scalar.
Use only declared training/validation feedback, freeze the candidate before final evaluation, and satisfy a justified meaningful-effect and valid uncertainty rule under fixed budgets.
New split evaluations are labelled extensions. Bigger Figure 2 stability effects, stronger age significance or exact figure reconstruction cannot count as decoder improvement.

current_sota.description: No separate current-SOTA decoding comparison is established.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending source cohort/fold binding and author baseline recovery. Once admitted, tune using only the declared original training and validation access, preserving both source age strata.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze method, transformations, hyperparameters, source cohort/fold manifest and access/resource ledger before the final same-fold decoder comparison.
episode.final_evaluation: A protected candidate-versus-author replay on the original Figure 5i partitions and full two-stratum score vector, after baseline qualification. No new split can establish a same-task paper win.
episode.baseline_policy: Preserve original published young/aged scores, reproduced circular-decoder scores and candidate scores separately. Figure 2 initial-evaluator-v1 remains calibration only.

blocking_issues: Exact original 61-session/cell roster, source map classification and downsampled train/test partitions are not bound.
Published stratum means are recovered, but the complete original session/repetition comparison vector and author replay are unresolved.
Existing initial-evaluator-v1 implements Figure 2 metrics, not the original Figure 5 position decoder; a qualified same-task evaluator is missing.
Task-specific effect/uncertainty rules, original-access policy and concrete episode budgets remain unfrozen.

legacy.notes: Preserve initial-evaluator-v1 Figure 2 kernels, generated controls and prospective age summaries as calibration only. The authorized overhaul identifies original Figure 5 position decoding as the source-native improvement route; current source_unresolved status admits no paper-win execution.
